passages.heading: Growing vegetables
passages.text: Vegetable gardens need fertile soil, compost and regular watering. Healthy roots absorb nutrients and moisture so plants can grow.

passages.heading: Growing vegetables
passages.text: Compost improves garden soil and feeds vegetable plants. Water the roots consistently and protect young seedlings from drying out.

passages.heading: Growing vegetables
passages.text: Keep vegetable seedlings watered in rich composted soil. Garden roots need moisture and nutrients for healthy plant growth.

passages.heading: Database transactions
passages.text: Database transactions protect against partial updates. A successful commit saves every write; rollback restores the previous state after failure.

passages.heading: Binary search trees
passages.text: A binary search tree stores ordered keys in left and right subtrees. Rotations balance the nodes to keep lookup efficient.

passages.text: Practice guitar scales slowly with a metronome. Repeat chord changes and listen carefully to the timing and pitch of each note.
